metadata.description:
# Claude Panel
A dockable chat window inside REAPER. Each message carries a text description of what is selected (tracks, items, MIDI notes, time selection, markers), so Claude can answer about the project in front of you.
It talks to Claude through the Claude Code command line (claude -p), signed in with your Claude plan. No API key is used.
## Requirements
- ReaImGui 0.9 or newer - Claude Code installed and signed in
## Notes
- 0.1 is read-only: Claude cannot change the project - Ctrl+Enter sends - Open Settings and press Test to check that the claude command is found
